research_role: article-level structured event extraction; no return forecast and no trading action
selection_basis: Operational correction after the v3.5 full extraction reached batch 108 and exposed the semantically equivalent affected-assets label Bitcoin (BTC). V3.6 canonicalizes only a closed allowlist of exact BTC aliases before applying every v3.5 validation rule. Unlisted derivatives such as Wrapped Bitcoin (WBTC) remain unchanged and still fail the direct-BTC contract. No event classification, evidence, market outcome, predictive metric, threshold, or trading result was consulted or altered.

prior_operational_failure.reason: one direct-BTC item used affected_assets label Bitcoin (BTC), while v3.5 accepted only the exact labels BTC or Bitcoin; atomic validation rejected the four-item batch

btc_asset_alias_policy.unlisted_values: preserve then apply the unchanged v3.5 validator

stage1_gate.decision: all requirements must pass before full-corpus extraction

stage2_only_if_stage1_passes.scope: one full extraction over 39393 articles; no outcome join, predictive test, threshold selection, backtest, or Tech overlay

prohibited: canonicalizing affected-assets values outside the frozen exact allowlist
changing prompt, schema, model digest, sample, batch size, or gate thresholds after Stage 1 begins
joining market outcomes before the full extraction artifact is complete and frozen
creating action, position size, or Tech overlay fields in the extractor
running more than one LLM worker
continuing compute at NVIDIA GPU temperature 75 C or above
